payout_value_note: Flat $75 to the referring member and $75 to the new member. No stated cap.
payout_quote: Refer a friend or family member to cPort Credit Union and you could receive $75! ... New members can also receive $75 by setting up Direct Deposit of your net pay within 60 days of opening your new Checking Account.
steps: Current member in good standing completes the referral form with their name and contact information and gives it to the friend.
Friend presents the form when opening a new checking account (new members 18+ only).
New member sets up direct deposit of net pay within 60 days of opening the checking account to receive their $75.
Bonus deposited within ten business days of the direct deposit.
